status: pilot decision aids, not team SLA or deployment approval
primary_operating_point: calibration FPR target 5%; actual outer FPR always reported separately
secondary_operating_point: calibration FPR target 1%, and fixed 0.5 model threshold

feature_expansion_candidate.comparison: candidate versus freshly trained M_base on identical eligible rows and splits
feature_expansion_candidate.alternative: FP reduction at least 20% while Recall loss is at most 2pp
feature_expansion_candidate.robustness: positive gain in at least two outer folds and two non-generic campaigns, inspect alternate calibration seed and 50-round sensitivity
feature_expansion_candidate.rule_comparison: report R1/R2/R3 actual operating points and same-information shallow tree; do not claim ML superiority from beating a weaker-information rule

hybrid_candidate.comparison: hybrid versus same feature model alone on identical eligible rows and splits
hybrid_candidate.requirements: combined calibration budget feasible in every outer fold; gain not confined to one campaign; report extra false positives and rescued positives

uncertain: tradeoff, inconsistent folds, insufficient calibration normals, extraction/source bias or only one-campaign benefit -> targeted follow-up rather than adoption
reject_this_hypothesis: no added detection and greater FP/cost, or effect explained by leakage/source artefacts
unseen_evaluation: not available in this pilot; D06 is previously studied development data; Test677 is not evaluated here
source_subset: complete-case comparisons on identical preselected cohort; population metric must not be equated with full-Train metrics
posthoc: any later amendment must be separately versioned and labelled exploratory, never overwrite this file after results
